settings.title: Store frozen
settings.text: Be sure to keep raw food frozen until ready for thawing. Thaw before feeding, avoid re-freezing.

settings.title: Defrost Properly
settings.text: Place portion in a container and allow to thaw in the fridge. To accelerate the thawing process, place in sink of lukewarm water for 15 - 30 minutes, not to cook.

settings.title: Storage and Safety
settings.text: Do not cook as our recipe contains bone. It is important to discard any thawed product that no longer look or smells fresh.

settings.title: Wash Well
settings.text: Standard safe hygienic practices should be followed at all times when handling fresh, raw food; ensure all utensils.
